listing.name: SSX (2012) — SSX (2012) — rexglue static recompilation (pmrazor)
listing.summary: The project reports races and saves on an RTX4070. UI glitches remain at 2x, and Linux and macOS are untested. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own SSX (2012) Xbox 360 complete extracted game files, including the original executable. This guide does not specify the exact supported region, revision or file hash. Check the project’s original-file requirements before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Build patched SDK, dump/generate SSX game code from own XEX and compile Windows runtime.

warnings: The project reports races and saves on an RTX4070. UI glitches remain at 2x, and Linux and macOS are untested.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
